headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate a single finished Chrome Web Store listing promotional tile, aspect ratio 11:7, ideally1760x1120, not panoramic. Attached image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for genuine native YouTube live chat anatomy; do not reuse actual creator/game/usernames/messages. Concept02: RED TYPE CAMPAIGN. Minimal boldly art-directed flat vivid YouTube-red background (#ff0033) filling canvas, huge sharp condensed white sans-serif at top left reading exactly 'Fullscreen' and 'Live Chat' on two lines. Both words HUGE and legible at thumbnail, Fullscreen ONE WORD not Full Screen. Large original adventure stream rectangular video along bottom 58% width 91% of tile, complete full video rectangle with right-hand dark native YouTube chat panel inside the video, about 34% of video width and 85% of video height, game still visible around its edges. Video shows original tiny orange-robed explorer crossing turquoise jungle ruins with warm afternoon light, no known game or licensed character. No device or fake room, no screenshot browser chrome. Chat must LOOK like YouTube: near-black flat pane with small 'Top chat' header, small down chevron and vertical three dots; 7 compact rows. Each row has small round avatar, muted gray @name directly followed by white message inline on same row, unboxed, NOT separate bubbles/cards and NOT placeholder bars. Fictional messages: @alex let's go!; @mira what a view; @sam GG; @jo hello chat; @ren nice; @ivy wow; @kai 🔥. Native-looking footer little own avatar + underlined 'Chat...' composer + smiley + small outline send triangle, all present. Make this enough real text to register as chat at 440x280. Flat crop-safe editorial design, controlled contrast, white huge headline and red matte framing. Crisp clean UI, simple thin video playback controls faint at bottom. No generic messaging bubbles, no black type headline, no neon, no3Dchrome, no multiple panes, no creator likenesses/logos/endorsement/ratingbadges. This is original promotional concept artwork not a real product screenshot.

Targeted composition correction:
Edit image1 into a Chrome Web Store tile with EXACT LANDSCAPE 11:7 ratio (1760 x 1120). Current image is TOO WIDE at 2.5:1. Recompose more TALL; do NOT preserve the current panorama shape. Maintain vivid red/white headline direction, exact white text 'Fullscreen' and 'Live Chat' each large on own row at top40%. Image2 is chat style reference only. In bottom60%, show ONE video as a proper wide 16:9 rectangle. Put native YouTube dark chat as OVERLAY INSIDE video, so original jungle adventure scenery continues BEHIND the chat and is visible above and below its bounds. Chat MUST NOT occupy a separate outside video sidebar. Keep chat Top chat/chevron/three dots, 7 compact small-avatar gray-handle white-message inline rows, and footer own avatar/Chat.../smiley/outline send triangle. Keep fictional handles/messages, no real creators. Entire tile exactly11:7, no stretching, no cropped text, no tall letterboxing. Shorter headline width, narrower video footprint if needed. FLAT RED BACKGROUND throughout outside the single video. Large clean type, lively original adventure stream. This is a targeted COMPOSITION edit: preserve red/white treatment and UI anatomy while correcting canvas ratio and chat OVERLAY ownership.
